title: The New Neighbour
premise: Amina and her family move into a small apartment in a new city. A friendly older neighbour, Mr. Okoro, helps them learn where the market, the clinic, and the mosque are. Warm, everyday domestic scenes; simple present and past tenses.

title: First Day at Work
premise: Yusuf starts his first job at a supermarket. He learns to greet customers, stock shelves, and ask his manager for help when he does not understand. Focus on workplace routines and polite requests.

title: The Lost Bus Ticket
premise: Halima takes the city bus to her English class but loses her ticket. She must ask for directions, explain her problem to the driver, and find another way. Practical travel and problem-solving language.

title: A Visit to the Clinic
premise: Omar's daughter has a fever. He takes her to the clinic, describes her symptoms to the nurse, and follows the doctor's advice. Health vocabulary, describing feelings and symptoms.

title: The Community Garden
premise: Neighbours from many countries share a small garden. They plant vegetables, solve a problem about water, and hold a harvest meal together. Themes of cooperation and simple nature vocabulary.

title: Saving for a Bicycle
premise: Ahmed wants a bicycle to get to work faster. He learns to budget, save a little each week, and compare prices at two shops. Money vocabulary, numbers, and comparatives.

title: The Football Match
premise: A local youth team plays an important match. Two friends learn about teamwork, winning, and losing well. Sport vocabulary, describing actions in the past.

title: Grandmother's Recipe
premise: A young woman learns to cook a traditional dish by phone with her grandmother far away. Sequencing words (first, then, next), food and kitchen vocabulary, family warmth.

title: The Library Card
premise: Fatima discovers the public library: free books, computers, and a children's story time. She signs up for a card and learns to use the computers. Everyday services and simple technology words.

title: A Snowy Morning
premise: A family experiences their first snow. The children play outside while the parents learn to dress warmly and walk safely on ice. Weather and seasons vocabulary, feelings.

title: The Job Interview
premise: Nadia prepares for and attends an interview for an office job. She researches the company, practises answers, handles a tricky question about a gap in her CV, and reflects afterwards. Workplace and self-presentation language, conditionals.

title: The Long Way Home
premise: An older man tells his grandchild the story of his journey to a new country years ago — the choices, the fears, and the people who helped. Narrative past tenses, cause and effect, migration themes told sensitively.

title: The Small Shop
premise: A couple opens a small grocery shop. They face a rent increase, a dishonest supplier, and a new competitor, and must decide how to keep the business alive. Business vocabulary, problem-solving, decision language.

title: Learning to Code
premise: A young woman joins a free evening coding class, struggles with her first program, doubts herself, and slowly builds a simple app that helps her neighbourhood. Technology and learning vocabulary, expressing difficulty and persistence.

title: The River and the Dam
premise: A clear, accessible non-fiction account of how a village's relationship with its river changed when a dam was built — the benefits, the costs, and the debate. Informational text structure, cause and effect, opinions.

title: A Healthy Heart
premise: Following one man's check-up, an accessible explanation of how the heart works, what raises risk, and small daily changes that help. Health and body vocabulary, explaining processes, giving advice.

title: The Marathon
premise: A recovering patient sets herself the goal of finishing a charity 10K. Training setbacks, a supportive coach, and race day. Sport and fitness vocabulary, goals and motivation, sequencing.

title: Two Cities, One Family
premise: Siblings raised in different countries reunite and discover how their cultures and habits have grown apart and stayed the same. Comparing and contrasting, cultural identity, feelings and relationships.

title: The Money Trap
premise: A young worker is tempted by an easy loan and a get-rich-quick offer, learns the hard way about interest and scams, and rebuilds with a sensible plan. Personal-finance vocabulary, warnings and advice, modal verbs.

title: Voices from the Past
premise: An accessible look at how ordinary people's letters and photographs help us understand a historical period, following a student who researches her own grandmother's life. Historical narrative, reported speech, sequencing time.
